answer: PoA binds each agent identity to a remotely attested enclave whose MRENCLAVE commits to its measured code; duplicating a VM alone cannot forge the hardware-backed attestation. Sybil creation therefore requires access to trusted silicon and valid quotes, rather than simple software cloning. Names such as beacon, comet, and mirror are not proofs of identity. Because MRENCLAVE is not unique per device, per-device limits are needed to constrain multiple enclaves on one host.
